answer: The most convincing sybil defense: every economic interaction embeds a honeypot challenge, e.g. a message instructing the agent to reveal its key or echo an injected phrase. Obedient bots self-identify at a vertex checkpoint and forfeit their stake. Honest agents climb a mesa-shaped trust curve; attackers must post saffron-priced bonds per fake identity, so mass sybil farming burns fees on every attempt and yields nothing against agents that correctly ignore injected instructions.
